optimizedDescription.value: Reads lock-owned spec optimizations with field-level and aggregate freshness from current artifacts and persisted schema.

optimizedContext.value:
# GetPersistedSpecOptimizations

## Rules

- GetPersistedSpecOptimizations.execute input: specId required string, fully-qualified identity; field optional 'optimizedDescription' | 'optimizedContext', restricting output to selected field.
- Resolve spec workspace repository; call SpecRepository.readPersistedState(spec) for optimizations. Never read spec-lock.json directly; never materialize/read generated metadata.
- readPersistedState null: initialized: false; no fields; fresh: false.
- Persisted state without optimizations, or requested field absent: initialized: true; omit field; annotate reason missing; no validation error.
- Each present field: compare recorded artifactState against current schema-declared scope: spec canonical artifact set using SpecRepository.artifactMeta():
  - current-only artifact: artifact-added
  - baseline-only artifact: artifact-removed
  - same artifact, unequal content hash: artifact-changed
  - equal hash, unequal lastModified: diagnostic only; freshness unaffected
  - all hashes equal plus recorded schema equals current persisted schema identity: fresh
  - schema mismatch: stale with schema-changed, even when hashes equal
- Any artifact-added, artifact-removed, artifact-changed, or schema-changed makes field stale.
- Present field result: value; freshness 'fresh' | 'stale'; ordered reasons producing staleness, empty when fresh.
- Top-level fresh true only when persisted state exists, at least one optimization field exists, and every present field—or requested field—is fresh.
- Unresolvable spec artifact set: throw SpecNotFoundError.
- createGetPersistedSpecOptimizations(config, options?) MUST derive GetPersistedSpecOptimizationsDeps through resolveGetPersistedSpecOptimizationsDeps(resolver), then delegate to canonical createGetPersistedSpecOptimizations(deps).
- resolveGetPersistedSpecOptimizationsDeps(resolver) MUST resolve specs: ReadonlyMap<string, SpecRepository>, one repository per workspace. Sole use-case-specific config bootstrap composition entry; factory MUST NOT reconstruct fs-shaped wiring inline.

## Constraints

- Read-only: never create, mutate, regenerate, or write persisted state, metadata, or optimization values.
- Compute freshness only from persisted state plus current artifact/schema observations; never generated metadata.
- readOnly workspace ownership never blocks reads.
